findings.text: the head arm was measured at base 6fa76c49 plus the node's own commits, but the done_when's first step orders the current origin/main merged before the rerun and origin/main had advanced to cb557f9711, 55 files ahead, including reckon/_store.py which the exercised reckon/crew/promotion_evidence.py:18 imports, so this run does not establish that the file passes on the primary branch; the merged result is the separately dispatched test node's measure per the brief.

the manifest's failure_attribution names two census cases that failed in a first baseline arm over a git-archive extraction, but that arm's log was overwritten by the re-measured arm, so the attributed failure ids have no red log a reader can open; only logs/sbatch2.log:3 ('suite-baseline EXIT=1') still records that the first attempt failed.

verdicts.verdict: read the node goal 'Make tests/test_a_gate_names_its_arms.py pass in full on the primary branch' against the gate log; tests/test_a_gate_names_its_arms.py:209 now presents the fixture's delivered commit and the named file reports 5 passed at head, so the goal's deliverable is met at the landed head.

the done_when names tests/test_a_gate_names_its_arms.py at head with SLURM_JOB_ID unset plus a base run and an armed arm pair derived from the delivery manifest's baseline_suite and after_suite; the manifest's tests: line and logs/gate-head.log (5 passed, EXIT=0, slurm_job_id unset) and logs/gate-base.log (5 failed, EXIT=1) assert it, while the done_when's first step, merging the current origin/main, was not performed.
read the node's declared paths reckon, tests and docs/evidence/fragments/queued-work-needs-no-workaround; git diff --name-only against base 6fa76c49 lists three files and every one lies inside them.

read manifest.md of the reviewed run; it records status complete, the five commits, the gate command on line 11, four log paths, the base arm's five failing ids and the suite arms' 58-passed pair, and its negative_control_log names logs/gate-base.log.

read the five commits against base 6fa76c49: f22588c6 replaces --no-commit with --commit <the fixture's head> in tests/test_a_gate_names_its_arms.py:209-228, and f3435999, 0f2d2108, 6e1e34a8 and e6f8c86b4 revise the two evidence fragments to quote stable figures, with no product line touched.
